hero.title: Hallimane Restaurant: Bangalore's Authentic Taste of Village Delights
hero.subtitle: Step into a timeless village ambience and savor fresh, hygienic, and delicious rural cuisine, a Bangalore landmark for over 20 years.

about.title: The Hallimane Story: Authentic Rural Charm
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a cherished landmark in Bangalore's culinary landscape for well over two decades. Nestled in a vintage part of the city, our restaurant invites you to step into a truly authentic village ambience, complete with charming tiled roofs, rustic natural brick walls, high ceilings, and an abundance of lush greenery.
about.paragraph2: Acclaimed by media as one of Bangalore's best ethnic and value-for-money dining destinations, Hallimane is where locals and visitors alike come to savor the finest rural cuisine in an immersive setting. We are dedicated to serving fresh, hygienic, and utterly delicious rural food, always complemented by our exemplary and warm service.
